design: direction fit on H1 TRAIN split; every projected prompt is held out. Five populations: clean/harmful are H1 val, control is the same harmful request under weak framing (NOT harmless), attacks split by H2 judge.

positions.convention: negative index resolved against the PROMPT length, prefill-safe

bases.proj: raw diff-in-means direction, r/||r|| — what F1 has always reported
bases.proj_complement: outlier dims [0, 3, 4] zeroed then renormalized — the basis every causal stage (H3/F2/F3, H4 attribution) acts along
